Retained one particular supported target passage per completed source; a target range counts as one pair. The 31 targetless deferrals receive zero completed source or pair credit. No unexamined suggestion or source-only reading is counted as a completed cross-reference.

Native wording governs all comparisons: quoted ungodly speech is distinguished from the narrator; named historical allusions are qualified when the source is unnamed; ten months, the soul/body claims, hypothetical beasts, and transformation of creatures are not replaced with familiar assumptions.
